name: mifluent
description: Open-source morning brief on what changed around your business

scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @mifluent/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && npm run typecheck --workspace @mifluent/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @mifluent/worker
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && npm run db:migrate --workspace @mifluent/db
scripts.account:set-password: npm run build && npm run account:set-password --workspace @mifluent/web --
scripts.poll: npm run build && npm run poll --workspace @mifluent/worker
scripts.worker: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @mifluent/worker
scripts.discover: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/worker/src/discover.ts
scripts.embed:bench: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/worker/src/embed-bench.ts
scripts.digest:build: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/worker/src/digest-build.ts
scripts.pipeline:dry: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/worker/src/pipeline-dry-run.ts
scripts.telegram:webhook: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/worker/src/telegram-webhook.ts
